find: return raw !== null && (SHADOW_MAP_SIZES as readonly string[]).includes(raw) ? Number(raw) : null;
why: Accepts any integer as a shadow map size, so ?shadowMapSize=1000 or 8192 would reach the renderer instead of being rejected to the preset's size.
killedBy: parseDevFlags: single-setting render overrides (issue #735) rejects anything else to null, so the preset keeps its own setting
